body.name: Valid balanced assignment laws
body.construction: \(\mathfrak P^{\mathrm{bal}}_{N,K}=\{p\in\Delta(\mathcal Z_{N,K}):\sum_{z\in\mathcal Z_{N,K}}p(z)\mathbf 1(z_i=a)=K^{-1}\text{ for every }i\text{ and }a\}\). Thus every law has the fixed counts encoded by \(\mathcal Z_{N,K}\), total mass one, nonnegative atom probabilities, and marginal probabilities \(\Pr_p(Z_i=a)=1/K\), but no unit-exchangeability or arm-exchangeability restriction.
